doctrine: Preserve current Havenwild functionality while extracting generic editor contracts.
Game Canvas, Assets, Pixel, Animation, Character, Logic, Sound, docks, command registry, validation, and Play Session are generic editor systems.
Havenwild values move behind project-profile data and adapters rather than remaining permanent editor constants.
The generic editor must offer straightforward creation workflows that can recreate project-profile values without hand-written project-only code.
Project profiles are generated from templates, user choices, source libraries, semantic promotion, and certification results.
nonGoalsNow: Do not rename crates or executables in this phase.
Do not delete Havenwild-specific behavior before an equivalent ProjectProfile path exists.
Do not break current internal PCC, Full Gate, Play, Play From Here, or existing editor panels.

futureExtraction.phase1: Add generic data contracts beside current code.
futureExtraction.phase2: Route current Havenwild behavior through generic contracts.
futureExtraction.phase4: Expose template/wizard workflows so those values can be recreated for any 2D project.
futureExtraction.phase5: Only then consider external product packaging/renaming.
